header: "EV specifications, in plain words": the second tab of the electric-car window. A person who is not an electrical engineer meets the same dozen words on every EV page, advert and spec sheet (kW, kWh, bhp, PS, Nm, volt, LFP, Blade battery, AC and DC charging, CCS2, C-rate). I wrote this file to say what each means, in the order a buyer meets them, in six distinct sections. Pure data, no React (EvGuide.tsx draws it); tested in evGuide.selftest.ts. Where a figure is a maker's claim or a news report, the section says so and names it; where a figure is arithmetic (bhp from kW) it is computed here from the same constants as the converter (src/tools/converter/units.ts). The Blade-battery facts are BYD's own (its blog of January 22, 2023) and, for the Indian cars, Autocar India, Autocar Professional and S&P Global Mobility. Nothing here is a price, a range figure for a named car or a warranty.
